table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	City,
	Date,
	PatientCode,
	RegNo, 
	Name, 
	FName,
	DOB,
	Gender,
	Customer = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = Patient.CustCode),
	PatientCatCode,
	PatientCategory = (SELECT PC.Name FROM PatientCategory PC WHERE PC.PatientCatCode = Patient.PatientCatCode),
	Phone,
	Phone2,
	MobileNo1,
	MobileNo2,
	MobileNo3,
	Address=Address1,
	MedicineCount=ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(SL.PatientCode) FROM SaleLedger SL WHERE SL.PatientCode = Patient.PatientCode), 0),
	Doctor = (SELECT D.Name From Doctors D WHERE Patient.DoctCode=D.DoctCode)
FROM 
	Patient
WHERE 
	PatientCatCode IN (:ai_patientcatcode) AND
	DATE BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate
ORDER BY
	City,
	Patient.Name
table.sort: city A, date A, name A, regno A
